newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends mixed, soy break trims early gains.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends mixed, soy break trims early gains.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed mixed, as a late break in CBOT soybean futures trimmed early gains, traders said.
"Beans signaled the way, and the way beans broke, people suspect the move is over for the moment," a trader said.
Fund selling hit the CBOT soybean complex in late dealings and CBOT wheat also felt the brunt of late commission house and local selling.
KCBT wheat was caught in the middle.
The March contract held firm early on commercial buying, traders said.
"Cargill came out of the chute bidding for March at $4.22 and bought 500,000 bushels," a trader said.
The session high for March was $4.24-1/2, near the middle of first chart resistance at $4.22-1/2 and second resistance at $4.28, according to technical traders.
KCBT wheat closed three cents lower to two higher, with March down one at $4.19.
